verdict.rationale: The evidence shows ReelMimic runs locally on your own computer using your own Claude Code or Codex, but it never documents a training opt-out or any statement about whether user data is used for model training. Local execution is an adjacent privacy property, not the capability itself, and whether data trains models would depend on the external AI providers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
